status: PROVISIONAL — NOT GOVERNING. First-pass Gate 3.1 batch-2 decisions: the 24 consumer-map fields not in batch 1. Pending independent review and owner sign-off. Admits nothing; Gate 3.2/3.3 not started.
rules: None of these 24 fields has a numeric threshold literal in a live consumer; that is why they were not in batch 1. Thresholds they do depend on are read from tables (PROFILES, V5_THRESH). Those are listed under thresholdsByReference with provenance UNKNOWN. They are not invented.

§14A's vocabulary has four classes: HARD_STRUCTURAL_PREDICATE, RAW_MODEL_FEATURE, RESEARCH_HEURISTIC and LEGACY_REMOVE. §14B's destinations (named Layer-1 boolean, capital feature, advisory feature, research heuristic, removed) are recorded separately as destination14B, so the two layers are not merged.
Fields whose destination is Gate 4 are classified here (§14A). Their replacement design is Gate 4 work, and this review does not authorise it.

hp1.basis: This is execution and configuration admission (route environment, connection, armed state, mode), not a market-validity predicate.

BROKER_EXECUTION_ADMISSION.destination14B: Removed from state. Successor: Gate-4 EXECUTION_POLICY_ADMITTED and the Broker Execution Policy (§7.10–7.11). Failure locks execution and must not demote a valid conviction state.
BROKER_EXECUTION_ADMISSION.cbot: ADR-0008: replaced by the signed Execution Authority Manifest that binds brokerAdapterHash, plus the cBot's local account-type allow-list and kill switch.

hp1.basis: This is order payload data, not a predicate.

BROKER_ORDER_PAYLOAD.destination14B: Removed. Successor: the typed, hashed Layer-4A entry intent and SubmissionEnvelope (§10.3, §10.9), where every field has declared provenance.
BROKER_ORDER_PAYLOAD.cbot: ADR-0008: the cBot accepts only signed SubmissionEnvelopes, never a browser-assembled payload.

hp1.basis: This is a transport action.

BROKER_SUBMISSION.destination14B: Removed. Successor: the Broker Execution Boundary, with deterministic identity, durable reservation and reconciliation (§10.9–10.10, SB-1…SB-18).
BROKER_SUBMISSION.cbot: ADR-0008: the cBot is the broker-side half of this boundary.

classification.scope: The catalogue's ADVISORY_FEATURE is a §14B destination, not one of §14A's four classes. Of the four, RESEARCH_HEURISTIC (no capital authority) is closest for advisory data-health observations. The reviewer should confirm or pick another class.

hp1.basis: This is advisory and has no live consumers.

DATA_ADVISORY_FEATURES.destination14B: Advisory feature (advisoryFeatureSchema). Structurally unreachable from capital inference (§7.5; G-7; Gate 3 test 'Advisory features are structurally unreachable from capital inference').

hp1.basis: This is a composite reason array, not a predicate. Its thresholds were decided in batch 1 under DATA_HEALTH_OK and TICK_FRESHNESS.

DATA_HEALTH_REASONS.destination14B: Removed. Successor: named Layer-1 reason codes emitted by each admitted data-validity predicate.

classification.scope: The catalogue has LEGACY_REMOVE / CANDIDATE_UNADMITTED. But §6.4 makes it a named Layer-1 predicate ('ENTRY_EVENT_CONFIRMED is a named Layer-1 predicate and must pass §14C'), and §4.4 requires a fresh one for FIRE. So the field is a required hard-predicate candidate. It is not a legacy field to remove. It does not exist yet: no definition, no threshold.

hp1.basis: It has no definition yet. The catalogue's warning stands: 'the current assessTrigger/lifecycle thresholds cannot be renamed into authority.'

hp2.basis: No threshold exists. Every constituent, when defined, needs HP-3 provenance.

ENTRY_EVENT_CONFIRMED.destination14B: Named Layer-1 boolean, once defined at Gate 3.2 and 3.5 and tested at 3.3. Its freshness window is separate: FE-1, fireEventFreshnessWindow[profile], [UNSET], State Policy.
openQuestions: Its closed-bar definition is Gate 3.2/3.5 work. Batch 1 left TRIGGER_FRESHNESS, LIFECYCLE_STAGE and ENTRY_EXTENSION at HP-1 NOT_ESTABLISHED for the same reason.

hp1.basis: This is a policy duration, not market validity.

EXECUTION_COOLDOWN.destination14B: Removed from candidate and state. Successor, if kept: a Broker Execution Policy or Risk policy value, validated.

FAMILY_EXECUTION_PERMISSION.destination14B: Removed. Successor: Gate-4 execution admission. It must not alter a valid conviction state, and it must not be modelled as commercial entitlement (ADR-0007 keeps entitlement free of execution authority).

LEGACY_EVAL_DIRECTION.destination14B: A capital feature only if a validated model uses it. The candidate's direction comes from the explicit lifecycle candidate, never this hidden output.

LEGACY_EVAL_FAMILY_COUNTS.destination14B: A capital feature or diagnostics, only if a later validated model uses them.

hp1.basis: primarySetupQualified (an active candidate in TOUCH/HOLD/TRIGGER stage in the same direction) loosens both legacy gates. READY: score >= (primary ? 0.46 : V5_THRESH.ready 0.50), regimeConf >= (primary ? 0.50 : 0.60), broad families >= (primary ? 2 : 3). FIRE: score >= (primary ? 0.50 : V5_THRESH.fire 0.58), regimeConf >= (primary ? 0.52 : 0.65). That is a threshold shortcut by stage membership with no independent safety meaning.

LEGACY_EVAL_PRIMARY_SETUP.destination14B: Removed. The lifecycle is explicit in Layer 1 (§6.3).

thresholdsByReference.item: READY 0.46/0.50 score, 0.50/0.60 regime, 2/3 families; FIRE 0.50/0.58 score, 0.52/0.65 regime (primary/non-primary)

hp1.basis: This is a sizing value.

LEGACY_EVAL_RISK_SCALE.destination14B: Removed. Successor: Gate-4 Risk/Sizing Policy (§7.8). Batch 1 RISK_SCALE recorded the truthiness fallback in makeIntent (Number(evaln.riskScale) || 1).

classification.scope: The catalogue has RAW_MODEL_FEATURE. The live use is a weighted, uncalibrated score that gates FIRE (score < V5_THRESH.fire). §14B: 'pWin and EV are the only continuous quantities permitted to gate state'. §14A: 'No unnamed weighted scalar survives because a consumer depends on it.' So the current use is removed. Its components may come back only as named capital features inside a validated model. This matches batch 1's OPPORTUNITY_SCORE decision.

hp1.basis: This is a continuous score.

LEGACY_EVAL_SCORE.destination14B: Removed as state authority. Its components may become capital features.

thresholdsByReference.item: V5_THRESH {watch 0.42, ready 0.50, fire 0.58}; primary-setup READY 0.46 / FIRE 0.50

LEGACY_EXECUTION_PERMISSION_ASSERTION.cbot: ADR-0008 must treat any permission field inside a payload as data, never as authority. The cBot verifies the signed manifest and envelope instead.

RISK_REDUCING_DATA_BYPASS.cbot: ADR-0008 §7: risk-reducing actions get their own path. They never borrow risk-increasing admission.
